conversation_id.description: The conversation to read. Omit it to read the current conversation. Hidden conversations (reflection, dream and subagent runs) are refused with an error — this tool only reads ordinary conversations.

message_start.description: First visible message to include, 1-based and inclusive. Visible messages are the cleaned ones this tool prints; reasoning and tool rows are not counted. Defaults to 1.

message_end.description: Last visible message to include, 1-based and inclusive. Defaults to the last message. The range is applied before `query` and `offset`.

query.description: Keep only messages whose visible text contains this substring, case-insensitively. Useful for finding where a decision or a piece of work appeared without paging through everything.

max_chars.description: Character budget for this page, including the header and the paging note. Defaults to 8000. A long message is cut with an ellipsis when the budget runs out.

offset.description: Number of matching messages to skip, for paging. Pass the `next offset` the previous page reported, keeping `query`, `message_start` and `message_end` the same; do not guess an offset.
